notes.title: Drilly Willis 1.2 UPDATE -- New Game +, Boss Fights, Difficulty Modes, & More!
notes.content:
Drilly Willis wishes a Merry Christmas to all who celebrate it, and knows that you probably got some fancy game with AAA graphics today that nonetheless disappointed you the moment you turned it on and discovered that it had zero drillheaded heroes and zero ice cream monsters.

Never fear! Drilly is here to save your holiday misery with a big, red-cheeked update...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715032/536bc12e19d471b6c18329173465aad8f20d6d21.png[/img]

[u]DRILLY WILLIS 1.2[/u]
[list]
[*] NEW GAME +: Keep your purchased upgrades, in-game achievements, and map, and play the game again! If you've beaten the game and started to re-explore The Banished World your save will be automatically updated to a NEW GAME + save.
[*] SMOOTHER BOSS FIGHTS: Attack patterns, HP levels, and damage have been adjusted to make bosses a more forgiving and rewarding experience without taking away the core challenge. Which brings us to...
[*] DIFFICULTY MODES: You can now choose your difficulty level when you start a new game as well as any time while playing via the OPTIONS menu. Want a balanced experienced? Select ROCK difficulty. Want those brutal boss battles back? Select METAL. Want enemies to seemingly fall right onto your drill and die easily? Choose POP.
[*] UNLOCKABLE THRASH DIFFICULTY: Beat the game at least once to unlock THRASH, a difficulty so extreme it probably shouldn't even exist. But it does... oh, yes, it does!
[*] SLANTED PLATFORMS COLLISION: A bug with slanted platforms has been fixed. The game should better sense Drilly's feet touching a slanted platform while running.
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416150/Drilly_Willis/]BUY DRILLY WILLIS ON STEAM![/url]

Thank you, as always, for supporting this little game that I so loved making.

Mike
Private Pook Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715032/89a3cd1d540bb25dcb5c1def374e46ab9fe9c26b.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.1 Released - Controller Fixes and Small Bugs Addressed
notes.content:
DRILLY WILLIS VERSION 1.1 RELEASE NOTES:

1) Controllers and More Controllers!

Fixed several controller compatibility and button mapping issues for PS4 Dual Shock and XBox 360 controllers. Most common controllers should now work perfectly.

2) MHOOK Compatible

Fixed cursor lock issue so that Drilly Willis can now be played with MHOOK, providing more inclusivity for gamers with disabilities.

3) Several Small Bug Fixes

A few speed, frame rate, and soft lock issues fixed.

Thank you to everyone who has bought and played the game so far!

Mike
Private Pook Games
[url=https://privatepook.com]Private Pook Games Website[/url]
